item.title: Mito Castle Remains: The Understated Seat of a Powerful Clan — Guide
item.description: Mito Castle was once the seat of the Mito Tokugawa, one of three branch families of the ruling Tokugawa shogunate, making it historically significant despite lacking the towering keep of more famous castles. Much of the original structure was lost over time, but the site preserves substantial earthworks and a dry moat (karabori), along with a reconstructed gate, offering visitors a quieter, more contemplative walk through the layered history of Mito’s feudal past, set within what is now a school and park complex.
